title: Normalized finite-field stages and their coherence
statement: Let l be prime. Coefficient fields are finite extensions of Q_l with specified Q_l-algebra embeddings. Use the actual completed coefficient sheaves and raw rationalizations of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Schemes supporting a constructible rational category are assumed noetherian, finite-dimensional, with l invertible; ambient operation comparisons are for arbitrary scheme morphisms g : X → Y in the actual ambient derived categories. Inside any ambient Q_l-field, each finite coefficient field gives its raw rational constructible stage. Normalize the transition for an equal pair of fields to the literal identity. The tensor-balancing associators, conjugated by this normalization, satisfy the two unit equations and four-field pentagon. Each transition is additive and triangulated and the normalized associators commute with integer shifts.

proof.text: Use finite subfields as coefficient stages and their actual inclusion embeddings. For a repeated field choose the literal identity transition and normalize the raw tensor functor with its tensor unit. Otherwise keep the raw tensor transition. Conjugate the balanced tensor associator by these normalization isomorphisms.

On K-flat models both four-field pentagon paths multiply the three scalar tensor factors in the same order, and each unit path multiplies by one. The normalized units give the two repeated-field equations; conjugating preserves the pentagon. Exactness of each branch follows from rational tensor exactness or the identity. The balanced shift equation, whiskering and normalization give the normalized associator shift equation.
